note: Registry of benchmark runs the site may show. A run is a batch under benchmarks/results/code/runs/<label>/ scored under evaluator label <label>. publishable is a provenance judgement recorded when the run was reviewed, not a number: a run whose harness tree was dirty, or that stopped part way, is shown with that flag rather than hidden. Every figure for a run is still read from its own files. evaluator_label names the label the evaluator reports carry when it differs from the run directory (older runs scored before --label existed).

runs.label: base50-light
runs.note: Light tier (Sonnet implements, gpt-5.6-terra as the Codex seat). Arms A, B, E complete on all 50 tasks.

runs.label: base50
runs.note: Frontier tier partial run (Fable, gpt-5.6-sol). Generated from a dirty harness worktree and stopped part way through A and B; kept as-is and shown with this flag, never as a headline.

runs.label: poc-flask-5014
runs.note: One-task proof of concept: every arm executes end to end and reaches the official evaluator. Not a measurement. Its evaluator reports carry the label code-bench (the default before --label existed).
